findings.title: DaemonLaunchGate timeout callback can race after markReady (ready→error)
findings.closure_note: Added a local `ready` guard in the useEffect closure so the timeout callback cannot set error after markReady has already fired.

findings.title: Missing explicit retry→reload and degraded Vitest cases for DaemonLaunchGate
findings.closure_note: Added Vitest cases in daemon-launch-gate.test.tsx: retry button reloads the window, and degraded initial status passes the gate.

findings.title: Settings re-run test does not mount DaemonLaunchGate
findings.closure_note: Extended the re-run test mount in settings-setup-section.test.tsx to wrap routes with DaemonLaunchGate, mirroring the production App shell.
